input.title: ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
input.bodyText:
ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
Zombie Match 3D (Puzzles vs Zombies). Written 1 Oct 2025 by Julia Lawson for the game as it is today. If our core gameplay changes, we will redo the affected parts with you in November.

1. Start date
Kickoff with PlayableX: Monday 3 November 2025. The project is paused until then.

2. Scenario and what it is for
We picked Scenario 1: the core gameplay, shown simply. The playable is meant to filter for retention. It should show players the real game, so the ones who install are the ones who will like it, while still being fun. It is not meant to chase the cheapest CPI with something unrelated to the game. Presenting the core mechanic in its simplest form is what you recommended too.

3. How the level plays (from our design doc)
- Items sit in a 3D physics pile. The player taps or drags items into a tray at the bottom.
- The tray has 7 slots. Three matching items in the tray clear, and each cleared triple fires that item at the zombies.
- Different items hit zombies differently: for example, Grenade is powerful, Couch does splash damage, and Plushie Chick is weak but funny.
- Zombies walk toward the player. When they reach the player they drain the player's HP.
- Win: every zombie on screen is eliminated.
- Lose: the zombies reach the player and HP runs out.
- Filling all 7 slots without a match is not a loss. It is a blunder: the tray clears, the surviving zombies enrage, and play continues. Only zero HP shows the lose screen.
- The rocket launcher (our Cannon, sent with its projectile) is the weapon on screen.
Reference: our deck "ZM3D playable - reference level" (built 23 Sep, recorded by Brian) shows the level we built for you. Note that its board had Couch and Pillow and Plushie Bunny; under this brief those two are extras, and the default eight are listed below.

4. The board: eight default items
Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick (the one you called the duck), Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant, Dynamite.
Every other board item on our pack list is an extra you can swap in (you offered to make the board editable). The hand-off list marks each board item Default or Extra.
Still owed for the default eight: Cactus Plant, which has new pot colour versions coming from Claire. The other seven are already with you or ready in the outgoing folder.

5. Zombies and animation
Four zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player.
One animation: walk.
All four are in the Unity package Marcus sent on 26 Sep, which you have already reviewed. Please re-rig just these four in Spine with the walk animation only. We can add more zombies later if size allows.

6. Sound and music
What you can use, all as .wav:
- Ours and ready now: Matching sound, Success sound, Failure sound.
- Background music: a new track made for the ad (not the in-game track). Calvin is still cutting it down to a loop, and it will follow.
- Rocket sound and Explosion sound: the current versions come from a sound library and a bought pack, so we are not handing them over. We will send our own versions when Calvin has made them. Until then, leave those cues silent or use placeholders on your side.
Music start rule (yours, from the Domino Delights playable): music starts only after the player's first tap, never on load. The same goes for the timer: it must not start before the player can see the playable.

7. Formats (as you told us, still holds)
- 3D: .fbx (Binary, not ASCII), .glb or .blend
- 2D: .png (2D animation parts separated)
- Font: .ttf or .woff2
- Sound: .mp3 or .wav

8. What is still coming from us
See the hand-off list (sheet "ZM3D playable - hand-off list"). It has one row per line of our pack list, each marked Delivered (you have it), Ready (exported and in our outgoing folder) or Owed (still to do, with what is owed and who has it). Counts as of 1 Oct: 8 Delivered, 48 Ready, 40 Owed.

input.message:
Done. Brief (doc) and hand-off list (sheet) are in my Drive, shared view-only with you, Brian, Robert and PlayableX intake. Both links are posted in the PlayableX channel.

Counts across the 96 lines of Brian's pack list:
• **Delivered: 8**: Couch, Couch and Pillow, Grenade, Plushie Bunny, Plushie Chick, Cannon, Background, Zombie characters (Marcus's pack)
• **Ready: 48**
• **Owed: 40**

Where Brian's notes no longer hold:
• **Bathroom (12)**: Claire said on 29 Sep she's redoing the UVs and that Friday's files are the old version. They go again from her.
• **Cactus, Chainsaw, Cone**: new colour versions were made 29 Sep, after export. They go again from Claire. Cactus is one of the default 8, and the only default item still owed.
• **8 music instruments**: per Brian's note on 30 Sep, the zip got cut off on upload and they aren't in the folder. Brian will put them back.
• **Rocket and Explosion sounds**: these are from Soundly and an Asset Store pack, so they stay with us until Calvin makes our own versions.

The rest of Owed: Claire 6 models not exported yet, Brian 5 exports plus 2 Figma PNG lines, Calvin the music loop, Martin the fonts. All 40 Owed tickets are in Todo with a comment. Robert's picks stand: walk, plus Party Girl, Plumber, Magician and Football Player.

Hi <@PERSON_6078_SLACK_ID>, ahead of the 3 Nov kickoff, here's what you'll build from and what's still coming from us. Both are shared view-only with intake@playablex.ai.

• **Brief:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/bb80b125a1c2ab9fbb268584/edit
  Scenario 1, the 8 default board items (every other board item is a swap-in extra), the 4 zombies with the walk animation only (Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player, all from the Unity package you've reviewed), win/lose and the 7-slot tray, sound, and the music-after-first-tap rule.
• **Hand-off list:** https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_uQ4kS7xJcx2zokJTjgbL0g4rqQNRP_rA9gMl5f2WpI/edit
  One row per asset, marked Delivered / Ready / Owed. As of today: 8 Delivered, 48 Ready, 40 still owed from us.

The brief is written for the game as it is today. If our core gameplay changes, we'll go through the affected parts with you in November.
